messages.text: I ordered the BS-4 several months ago.  It said shipping on 10/31.  Now it says 11/31.  When will my BS-4 ship?
Handed to the team · BS-4 pre-order past two promised dates, date moved again; needs a firm date and

Eric, I'm sorry. The B.4 listing now reads November 30, 2026, and that's after we told you October 4 and then the second week of October. Two dates missed is two too many.

I don't want to hand you a third date I can't stand behind, so I've put your order in front of the team to get a real commitment, along with the Glod P3 money you moved onto it. They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

If you'd rather not wait on Bitfortun at all, say the word and we'll look at moving you onto something in stock now.
Ok I'll wait until monday but if it's not shipping soon I will need a refund.

Understood, Eric. I've noted that on the order so the team has it in front of them Monday.

Nothing has shipped on it, so you're not locked in. They'll come back with the date and your options in the same email.
Before you go, one thing: back in September you moved the Glod P3 money onto the BS-4 — what made the BS-4 the one you wanted instead of something in stock?

Ok, cool.  No worries.
